title: The CyberUnicorn live screen shows the current menu as soon as it opens

source.ref: Owner 2026-10-20 in the project thread, with a screenshot after LIVE-1193 shipped: 'Unicorn is not streaming' (linked over USB on CU5K 0.1.1, header LIVE, screen black but for a few pixels).

detail: FILED AND CLOSED 2026-10-20. PREMISE RE-TESTED: `display start` makes Bruce redraw its whole menu at once, and the console only mounts the mirror canvas after that call returns, so the canvas subscribed after the frame had passed; a still menu sends nothing more, leaving it black (the few pixels were the animated border). Before LIVE-1193 the same race hid behind the Refresh button. Built: RpcClient keeps the screen packets since the last fillScreen (capped at 8000) and watchScreen replays them before following the stream; the backlog empties when streaming stops or the client closes. MirrorCanvas uses watchScreen. Unit test in lib/device/protocol.test.ts.

verify.note: Fails when watchScreen or its replay goes, the backlog stops restarting at fillScreen, the canvas stops using it, or the test goes.
